statement: The Bank of England raises Bank Rate at a Monetary Policy Committee decision announced between 2026-11-16 and 2027-02-26.
resolution: The Bank of England official Bank Rate history shows at least one increase in Bank Rate with a change date between 2026-11-16 and 2027-02-26.
failure_condition: Bank Rate was not increased at any point between 2026-11-16 and 2027-02-26.

statement: ICE Brent front-month futures settle above 105.00 dollars per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-11-16 and 2026-12-18. Reference: 95.84 on the packet date.
resolution: ICE Brent front-month daily settlement is above 105.00 on at least one trading day between 2026-11-16 and 2026-12-18. Reference: 95.84 on the packet date.
failure_condition: Every ICE Brent front-month settlement between 2026-11-16 and 2026-12-18 is at or below 105.00.

statement: The S&P 500 index closes below 7200.00 on at least one trading day between 2026-11-16 and 2026-12-18. Reference: 7561.67 on the packet date.
resolution: The official S&P 500 daily close is below 7200.00 on at least one trading day between 2026-11-16 and 2026-12-18. Reference: 7561.67 on the packet date.
failure_condition: Every S&P 500 daily close between 2026-11-16 and 2026-12-18 is at or above 7200.00.

statement: Donald Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin hold an in-person joint three-way meeting on Chinese territory between 2026-11-15 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: At least two of Reuters, AP and BBC report that all three leaders met together in person in a single session in China on a date between 2026-11-15 and 2026-11-30.
failure_condition: The three leaders did not sit together in one in-person session in China between 2026-11-15 and 2026-11-30.

statement: Representatives of the governments of Russia and Ukraine sign a written ceasefire, armistice or peace agreement between 2026-11-15 and 2027-01-31.
resolution: Reuters and AP both report that Russian and Ukrainian government representatives signed a written ceasefire, armistice or peace agreement on a date between 2026-11-15 and 2027-01-31.
failure_condition: No written ceasefire, armistice or peace agreement was signed by both governments between 2026-11-15 and 2027-01-31.

statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog adds a PostgreSQL vulnerability with a date-added value between 2026-11-15 and 2027-01-15.
resolution: The CISA KEV catalog carries at least one entry whose vendor or product field names PostgreSQL and whose date-added value falls between 2026-11-15 and 2027-01-15.
failure_condition: The KEV catalog contains no PostgreSQL entry with a date-added value between 2026-11-15 and 2027-01-15.

statement: An earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater occurs within 250 km of Lata, Solomon Islands (10.72S 165.80E) between 2026-11-15 and 2026-12-14 UTC.
resolution: The USGS ComCat catalog lists at least one event of magnitude 6.0 or greater within 250 km of 10.72S 165.80E with origin time between 2026-11-15 and 2026-12-14 UTC.
failure_condition: No earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater occurred within 250 km of 10.72S 165.80E between 2026-11-15 and 2026-12-14 UTC.

statement: Hakeem Jeffries is elected Speaker of the US House of Representatives in a roll call vote held between 2027-01-03 and 2027-01-15.
resolution: The Clerk of the House roll call record for the election of the Speaker, held between 2027-01-03 and 2027-01-15, shows Hakeem Jeffries elected.
failure_condition: Hakeem Jeffries was not elected Speaker in any House roll call held between 2027-01-03 and 2027-01-15.

statement: South Sudan holds nationwide voting in its national elections between 2027-02-01 and 2027-02-28.
resolution: At least two of Reuters, AP and AFP report that polling stations opened for national presidential or parliamentary voting in South Sudan on a date between 2027-02-01 and 2027-02-28.
failure_condition: National election voting did not take place in South Sudan between 2027-02-01 and 2027-02-28.

statement: A named person is criminally charged in connection with the explosive device found at an ethanol plant in the Peoria, Illinois area, with charges filed between 2026-11-15 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: A federal or Illinois state court docket, or a US Department of Justice or county prosecutor release, shows charges filed against a named person over the device between 2026-11-15 and 2026-12-31.
failure_condition: No named person was charged over the ethanol plant device between 2026-11-15 and 2026-12-31.
